set_name: STREET HUSTLE CCG — COAST TO COAST EDITION

keywords.name: SUPPLY_CHAIN
keywords.text: This Dealer deals 0 damage unless it has at least 1 Stash attached. (Ghost is exempt.)

keywords.name: HASTE
keywords.text: Can attack the same turn it enters play.

keywords.name: SHIELD
keywords.text: Prevents the next instance of damage that would be dealt to this card.

keywords.name: TRAVEL
keywords.text: When you play a Borough, you may move this Dealer to that Borough's zone.

keywords.name: CONNECTION
keywords.text: When this enters play, search your deck for a card with matching trait and reveal it.

keywords.name: TURF_WAR
keywords.text: When you control 3+ Boroughs, this card gains its Turf War bonus.

keywords.name: FEDERAL_HEAT
keywords.text: Opponent's Cop/Action cards cost +1 Heat to play while you control this.

keywords.name: SYNDICATE
keywords.text: Your other Dealers of the same faction get +1 ATK.

keywords.name: LAUNDER
keywords.text: When this Stash is discarded, gain 1 Heat.

keywords.name: PRESTIGE
keywords.text: Legendary-only: While this is in play, you win ties and your max hand size is +1.

keywords.name: CARTEL
keywords.text: Expansion 1: Import cards from outside the game.

keywords.name: BORDER
keywords.text: Expansion 1: Effects that cross zones.

keywords.name: MULE
keywords.text: Expansion 1: Move Stash between Dealers for free.

keywords.name: CRYPTO
keywords.text: Expansion 2: Pay Heat from your discard pile instead of pool.

keywords.name: ANONYMOUS
keywords.text: Expansion 2: Cannot be targeted by opponent's Actions.

keywords.name: DEAD_DROP
keywords.text: Expansion 2: Play face-down, reveal for effect.

keywords.name: CONTRABAND
keywords.text: Expansion 3: Stash that survives Dealer KO.

keywords.name: GUARD
keywords.text: Expansion 3: Dealer that protects your other cards.

keywords.name: YARD
keywords.text: Expansion 3: Special zone with unique rules.

keywords.name: COMMISSARY
keywords.text: Expansion 3: Buy cards from a shared pool.
